test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the following letter series and answer the question that follows.

(Left) A F R G H U I N H F W D C T V G Y J M K O Q (Right)

If every third letter in the above series is dropped, which letter would appear at the fifth place from the left?
solution:
We spot every third letter in the given series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d05bf36db7d68360a602dec89f5c435a9a12a20e152f439860e4ab7b27104712.png] 

Now when we drop every third letter, we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85f87bc9e3dbbe4935db985ecd8fcf3c956024c5b4b29367db60f97955638d2e.png] 

Now in the series, **the fifth letter from the left is I.**

Hence the correct answer is **option 4)**
